title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation Pipeline for Pharmacovigilance Data
summary: A custom RAG pipeline for natural-language querying over adverse-event case narratives, built on Google Cloud with full control over the retrieval stack.
bullets: Designed and deployed a custom RAG pipeline on Google Cloud (BigQuery, Vertex AI, Cloud Run) for natural-language querying over adverse-event case narratives, built without managed search products to retain control over chunking, embedding, and ranking.
